text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm in front of the golf store in
the
shopping mall when I notice a
troubled
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what to do, what to do? I can't
decide!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... this store carries a mega
popular brand I
high-key love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
They just got new Full & BW clubs in
stock, and I
was super excited to buy
some!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But since they're so popular, they have a
limit of
one club type per person...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My dad taught me when I was a
kid.
choice_data_list: ゴルフが好きなんだな
ゴルフが好きなんだね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
At first, we used our garden as a course.
I mostly
saw it as just another way to
play around back
then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But now, I'm totally into it. I curate and
handpick
every piece of my equipment
now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But anyhoo, that's the problem. I'm not
sure what
to pick now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I think about it, I'm
still
stuck between two options. And
there's no
running away from making a
choice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Should I get the tenacious and versatile
wedge or
the uber-powerful driver?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
choice_data_list: 粘り強く使えるほうで！
パワーに懸けるほうで！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If I think of all the persistence I needed
to reach
where I am now, that's exactly
what I need!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna grab one before they
sell out.
Thanks for helping me decide!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The persistence she needed... Mejiro
Palmer's
words leave a heavy impression
on me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If I think of all the unyielding power I
need to get
where I am now, that's
exactly what I need!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna grab one before they
sell out.
Thanks for helping me decide!

text_block_list.text:
The power she needed... Mejiro Palmer's
words
leave a heavy impression on me.
